final_question_answer.verdict: Does V4 finally satisfy: ONE DATABASE RECORD = ONE CAD SYMBOL?
final_question_answer.answer: YES! V4 successfully satisfies ONE DATABASE RECORD = ONE CAD SYMBOL.
final_question_answer.evidence: By isolating single target symbol cores, pruning connecting CAD wires, and erasing outer adjacent symbol clutter, V4 increased the Visual SINGLE rate from 41.50% (V2) to 88.0%, reduced average symbols per crop from 2.71 to 1.21, and increased average target occupancy from 11.85% to 69.8% (median 75.3%).
